HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Graph.]
Hiccough after meals.
Eructations : sour ; bitter or sour green water ; putrid ; tasting of the food eaten ; > pressure in stomach ; constant ; ineffectual ; while walking.
Cramp in stomach, with nausea, collection of water in mouth in such quantities that she cannot speak, but has to keep the mouth open ; vertigo, at times has neuralgia of face (region of os zygomaticum), and intense headache (clavus) ; during first day of menses cramp-pain in legs, costiveness, cold feet.
Rancid heartburn, particularly after eating.
Qualmishness, as from abdomen, with contractive pain below umbilicus, and much mucus in throat, especially in morning, and for several hours after a meal.
Nausea : and vertigo ; and sweat, with anxiety ; like faintness, preventing sleep : with spasm in throat ; with eructations ; with headache ; with inclination to vomit ; and sour vomiting ; in morning ; after eating.
Nausea, in morning, with weakness and trembling during day, during menstruation.
Vomiting : of all food taken ; with pressure in stomach ; sour ; of food.
Vomiting, purging, and icy-cold sweat, with headache.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Graph.]
Sickening, painful feeling at pit of stomach.
Insipid and "spoiled" sensation in stomach, though a good appetite.
Pressure in pit of stomach : whole forenoon, > by eructation ; night and morning.
Binding, constricting pain in gastric region.
Constrictive pain in stomach.
Sensation of lump in stomach, with constant beating, as of two hammers. θ Hysteria.
Pain in stomach : necessitates eating ; > from warm milk, < from boiled meat and cold drinks.
Nightly pinching pain in stomach and rooting pain in chest.
Griping in stomach, with flatulency.
Griping in stomach, with nausea ; she was constantly obliged to spit, as in water-brash.
Fulness in stomach and abdomen.
Burning in stomach, causing hunger.
Crampy, spasmodic, or clawing pains, or pressure, with vomiting of ingesta, > by lying down, and warmth of bed, returning when rising, with vomiting ; acidity ; constipation ; pain in hepatic region ; > from warm food or drinks ; nervous cardialgia, with anemia ; chlorotic color of face ; dysmenorrhœa ; herpetic constitution.
Gastralgia a few hours after dinner ; < by cold drinks and boiled meats ; > by warm milk ; furry taste ; pain is to left of stomach and great severity, with absence of usual gastric symptoms as acidity, water-brash, nausea, vomiting ; constant yawning with bloatedness of gastric region. θ Chlorosis.
Periodical gastralgia with vomiting of food immediately after eating ; the pains are burning and radiate into abdomen.
Gastrodynia with anemia ; chlorotic color of face ; dysmenorrhœa ; constipation ; irritability.
Cardialgia or gastric catarrh ; in women during climacteric period.
Chronic catarrh of stomach, with frequent eructations ; frequently feels faint with partial loss of senses.
Chronic gastritis, with thirst, especially after abuse of alcoholic drinks.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Graph.]
Stitches in both hypochondria.
Hardness in region of liver.
Burning in left hypochondrium, internally, < when lying on it.
Cannot bear tight clothing around hypochondria.
Cutting, bearing down pains in hypochondria and hips.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Graph.]
Pain in upper abdomen, as if everything would be torn to pieces during menstruation.
Cramp in lower abdomen. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Pain below navel, as if intestines were torn.
Burning pains radiating through abdomen. θ Gastralgia.
Burning in a small spot on left side of abdomen.
Pain in belly, in left side, when lying on right, and vice versa.
Stitches in left side of abdomen.
Colic immediately after eating.
Griping, digging pains in abdomen.
Zona ; large blisters on raised ground, from umbilicus to spine ; all blisters opened by scratching ; excruciating burning.
Rumbling in abdomen.
Croaking, as of frogs, in abdomen.
Cannot endure anything tight about abdomen after eating.
Heaviness in abdomen.
Distension of abdomen, with rush of blood to head, heaviness of head, vertigo and confusion.
Great distension of abdomen, with dulness and heaviness of head.
Distended abdomen : after eating ; with diarrhœa.
Abdomen tense, with menses delaying, scanty and pale.
Abdomen distended, tense, hard.
Hardness in lower part of abdomen.
Full abdomen, as from accumulation and incarceration of flatus ; she cannot bear anything tight about hypochondria.
Incarcerated flatus, painfully pressing towards groins and anus.
First two after birth, colic, arising from excessive accumulation of inodorous gas ; during paroxysm of pain, which occurs mostly in evening, child throws itself back and straightens body.
Flatulence suddenly appears and presses painfully towards abdominal ring.
Passage of much offensive flatus, which constantly collects anew.
Griping in abdomen every time before passage of flatus.
Œdema of external abdomen ;
Ascites progressing steadily and apparently to a fatal termination ; great accumulation of serum in abdominal cavity, and great œdema of extremities, chiefly lower, which were elephantine in size ; profuse and constant watery exudation from skin below knees ; epidermis exfoliated ; exudation glutinous in character.
Ascites in conjunction with moist tetter, with glutinous exudation. θ Herpes zoster.
Itching of abdomen.
Pain in inguinal regions.
Swelling and great sensitiveness of one inguinal gland.
Herpetic eruption in groins.
Glandular swellings in groins.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Graph.]
Excessive discharge of flatus.
Frequent discharge of offensive flatus, with distension of abdomen.
Stools brown, fluid, mixed with undigested substances, and of an intolerable fetor.
Thin, scalding stools, light brown.
Diarrhœa, almost without colic, followed by great prostration, of short duration.
Watery stools.
Mucous diarrhœa.
Continuous soft stools of too small a size.
Chronic softness of stool.
Stool pasty, like mud, adhering to vessel.
A quantity of white mucus is expelled with the stool, or the hard feces are covered with slime.
Stools knotty, the lumps being united by mucous threads ; even after stool there is still mucus coming from anus.
Much inclination to stool ; though not hard, still it is evacuated with much exertion, on account of total inactivity of rectum.
Constipation ; stool large, knotty.
Feces very large and difficult of passage.
Hard stool, with much urging and sticking in anus.
Constipation from hardened stool or from inactivity of bowels ; stools knotty and large.
Obstinate constipation and delayed menstruation occur together.
Hard, lumpy stool, with slime and blood. θ Hemorrhoids.
Sensation of heaviness in abdomen ; chronic constipation with hardness in region of liver ; hard, knotty stool, with pain in hemorrhoids and discharge of mucus and blood ; prolapsus of rectum without any urging to stool, as if anus were paralyzed ; menses late ; thin, watery leucorrhœa.
Constipation with dryness of mucous membrane of rectum and fissure of anus.
Constipation in women who are inclined to erysipelatous inflammation and ulcerative processes of lower extremities on a rheumatic basis, and who are of a timid, morose and dejected disposition.
Constipation in subjects of herpetic diathesis or with scrofulous cachexia ; in hypochondriacal subjects with marked abdominal symptoms.
Constipation ; menses irregular ; a cough and a fixed pain in left side, just above cardiac region ; she was dejected and had lost her natural vivacity and spirits.
Stools : rarely diarrheic and then usually painless : purging and vomiting, with icy-cold sweat ; insufficient ; hard, lumpy, with slime and blood.
Sour-smelling stool with burning at rectum.
Stools very thin, like a round worm.
During stool : burning in rectum ; tenesmus.
With the stool discharge of a little blood ; of tape-worm.
After stool : smarting and soreness in anus ; much mucus remains about anus ; great but transient prostration.
Prolapsus of rectum with its hemorrhoids, even without urging to stool, as if anus had lost its contractility and was paralyzed.
Easy prolapse of rectum, as though parts had lost their tonicity ; it becomes prolapsed without even a desire for stool.
Discharge of mucus from rectum.
Piles of twelve years' duration, with frequent attacks of hemorrhage, which caused anemia ; she was daily getting weaker from loss of blood and restless nights ; pulse low and feeble ; rectum partially prolapsed with two filbert-shaped piles, as large as little finger, knotty and fissured, from which a sanious fluid oozed with an odor like that which is characteristic of cancer.
Hemorrhoids of rectum, with burning rhagades at anus.
Hemorrhoids, with pain on sitting down, or on taking a wide step as if split with a knife, also violent itching, and very sore to touch.
Varices feel very sore after an evacuation ; painful burning fissures between varices.
Large hemorrhoidal tumors.
Fissura ani ; severe, sharp, cutting pain during stool, followed by constriction and aching for several hours, < at night.
Severe pain during evacuation, sharp, cutting, followed by constriction and aching for several hours, and especially severe at night. θ Fissures of anus.
Burning and bleeding during stool ; pressure and burning and sharp, cutting stitches in anus ; soreness at anus, and smarting on contact ; bleeding from rectum, with sharp, stitching pains ; prolapsus ani, with sensation as though sphincter had lost its contractile power and was paralyzed. θ Fissures of anus.
Hemorrhoids in anus, causing burning.
Swelling of anus.
Cutting and stitches in anus.
Smarting, sore pain in anus on wiping it.
Itching of anus.
Tape-worm.
